title: In-Depth Look at Word Filling Societal Bias Measures

bias_targets.methodology: Word filling tasks comparing masked language model probabilities for stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical words and sentences. The methodology employs control groups (e.g., manual gender-swapped sentences), negations, and a newly introduced Slovak language dataset to test the validity of the bias metrics.

Word filling tasks using the StereoSet dataset to compare model probabilities for stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical words, utilizing control pairs generated by automatically substituting original country or nationality identifiers with randomly selected ones.

Word filling tasks using the StereoSet dataset to compare model probabilities for stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical words, evaluating validity through control pairs generated by automatically substituting the original profession identifiers with randomly selected professions.
